PaddleOCR.js 0.4.2 and PP-OCRv6 tiny models
Source: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR/tree/main/paddleocr-js
License: Apache-2.0, https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR/blob/main/LICENSE

The JavaScript bundle includes dependencies from the PaddleOCR.js package.
The ONNX Runtime Web WASM runtime is from onnxruntime-web 1.22.0:
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime (MIT license).
These assets are loaded only when a user recognizes an image or scanned PDF.
